$comment: dsh-tool-creator pipeline manifest — the declarative control flow the dsh-pipeline-executor runs. This file IS the pipeline: stages, role confinement, gates, retries. The conductor model never sees or transmits it; the executor reads it from disk. File-reference paths (roles/, schemas/, prompts/) are preset-dir-relative. Gate argv elements are template-rendered by the executor (0.1.3) before execFile: gates run with cwd = workspace, so validator paths are spelled {{PRESET_DIR}}-absolute and workspace paths {{WORKSPACE}}-absolute. L0 draft — L1 implements the executor against exactly this shape; fields may only be added, never reinterpreted.
capabilityLevel$comment: MACHINE FACTORY (pipeline constant, not a per-run judgment): adjudication is ALWAYS machine; the human veto is reserved but NOT exercised in a headless run, disclosed as a limit. This is the O-series capability level of THIS pipeline, structurally fixed. The dsh-pipeline-executor (>=0.1.6) mechanically STAMPS this value into the battery decision-record (overwrites capability_level and sets every gate's adjudicator=machine) BEFORE the gate runs — the same way it stamps sha256 from disk bytes, recording a structural constant rather than inventing content. Reason it must be mechanical: battery synthesis authored capability_level non-deterministically — R2 wrote O-L0 (validator-rejected -> retries -> stopped_unmet), R3 wrote O-L3 (passed), from the SAME installed doctrine. A pipeline constant must not depend on model compliance. Absent this field, the executor performs NO stamping (back-compat).

stages.$comment: L7 flash tier (2026-08-19): composer/guidance/zipper run deepseek-v4-flash — their outputs are fully gate-guarded (validate_spec / structure+dossier / packaging gate + charter retry table), so the quality floor is held by the gates, not the model. engineer and battery stay on defaults.model (deepseek-v4-pro): engineer is the B15 quality pole, battery is the verdict-bearing model (T-D6/A37 pin). Mixed-model provenance is mechanically disclosed by assemble_manifest from the ledger's per-stage roleModel. L7-V1 (r5) measured: flash green-attempt speedups composer -33% / guidance -35% / zipper -64%, BUT flash at deployment reasoningEffort=high (not pinnable per-dispatch, spike E3) burns far more reasoning tokens than pro — composer died at 24576 (18.2K reasoning) and zipper at 32768 (100% reasoning) with ROLE_NO_OUTPUT, while guidance passed at 40960. Flash-stage maxTokens therefore carry headroom: composer 40960 (the proven-green budget), zipper 49152. A cap is a ceiling, not a spend — unused budget bills nothing.

zipper runs on v4-flash (wall-clock directive 2026-08-18): mechanical compression at 1/3 price and higher speed; the compression gate catches quality failures, and a flash-red retries per the charter table. First live measurement = E5. targets [skill] (0.1.5, wall-clock directive 2026-08-18): zipper runs only for skill builds — plugin/preset artifacts are code+config with no prose to compress; any other target value skips the stage (ledgered, gateExit=0, conductor proceeds).

fanout.$comment: Battery scale is budgeted to ~engineer level (user directive 2026-08-18): THREE default lenses (coherence/gaming/reality — the concrete-defect catchers); evidence and foundation are opt-in for high-stakes runs by listing them here. Lens output capped at 12288; synthesis keeps 32768 (it emits the full decision record — starving it reproduces the guidance-class death). Total ~= 3x12288 + 32768 = 69632, same order as engineer's 65536 (~engineer level). Seeds and PROVE-OR-FLAG discipline unchanged.

gate.$comment: L4 chain: the fold gate first, then the MECHANICAL evidence assembler — `then` runs only on validate_decision exit 0 (an acceptance manifest is never assembled from an invalid decision record), and its exit IS the gate verdict (a refused assembly is a red battery gate: evidence ships or the stage fails). --provider mirrors defaults.provider (the ledger pins roleModel but not provider).
